title: fix(types): retire the header-bar keys nothing reads or authors (nav, left, center, height) (objectui#10387)
body:
Fixes #10387
Clause-②: yes

Retires **all eight** `HeaderBarSchema` keys the `header-bar` renderer never reads (`title`, `logo`, `nav`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `sticky`, `height`) from both faces. It uses the ADR-0049 tombstone shape objectui#10286 used for `variant`: `?: never` on the TS face beside a `retirementTombstone(...)` refusal in the zod mirror. It also migrates the only in-tree authors (docs and a type-check example) to `crumbs` / `actions`.

Authority: objectui#7759 ruling 5617465269 rule 2 (objectui-own key, so the read site is the truth), D1-(ii) (both faces dead and the spec silent, so retire), and ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove. The PM seat ruled **decision A** on the four keys that had authors (`title`, `logo`, `right`, `sticky`): retire them in this PR and migrate the authors.

## 1. The read set, measured at runtime (not by grep)

A one-off probe (deleted afterwards, not committed) rendered `{ type: 'header-bar', crumbs: [{ label: 'Home' }] }` through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry inside `SidebarProvider`. It varied one key at a time and compared `innerHTML` with the render that omitted the key:

```
title="PROBEX"                         identical=true
logo="/probex.svg" | node | [node]     identical=true
nav=[{label,href}]                     identical=true
left / center / right = node | [node]  identical=true
sticky=true | false                    identical=true
height="PROBEX" | 99                   identical=true
className="probex-cls"                 identical=true
rightContent=node   (lit control)      identical=false, probe text present
```

The renderer's one function takes only `{ schema }` and reads `crumbs`, `search`, `actions` and `rightContent`. No spread props reach it.

Spec: `packages/spec/src` at objectstack `9d81af71` and the installed 17.4.0 `dist` have zero `header-bar` / `HeaderBar` hits. The control word `breadcrumb` hits in both.

## 2. Authors, and how they migrated

| key | in-tree authors before | migration |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `title` | `packages/types/README.md` (Composable example), `content/docs/guide/objectos-integration.mdx` (page `header`), `packages/types/examples/dashboard.ts`; inert `title: 'H'` filler in `header-bar-right-content-numeric-falsy.test.tsx` (3 sites) and `node-slot-numeric-falsy.test.tsx` (1 site) | README and guide: `crumbs: [{ label: 'My App' }]`; dashboard: `crumbs: [{ label: 'Object UI Dashboard' }]`; tests: filler dropped (it never rendered, so each test's `CHROME` baseline is unchanged) |
| `logo` | `packages/types/examples/dashboard.ts` (`'/logo.svg'`) | dropped |
| `right` | `packages/types/examples/dashboard.ts` (Profile button) | the button moved to `actions` |
| `sticky` | `packages/types/examples/dashboard.ts` (`true`) | dropped |
| `nav`, `left`, `center`, `height` | none | none needed |

The guide's header also carried an undeclared `navigation` bag that nothing reads (the page's `sidebar` already holds the same items). It was dropped together with `title`, because the node was rewritten anyway.

The `header-bar` registration `inputs` offer only `crumbs`, `search`, `actions` and `rightContent`, so the designer never offered any of the eight.

## 3. Ledger (`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`)

- The `navigation.zod.ts#HeaderBarSchema` `WiderThanDeclared` entry (`logo`) and its `WIDER_ARMS` row (`['CONCRETE', 'CONCRETE']`) are removed. A note records where the entry stood.
- The WIDER header now reads **7 entries / 9 keys / 9 arms, split 5 SCHEMA-NODE / 4 CONCRETE / 0 MIXED / 0 unions**. Its history now has this PR's sentence (it read 8 / 10 / 11, split 5 / 5 / 0 / 1) above objectui#10334's sentence (8 / 11 / 12, split 5 / 6 / 0 / 1). The derivation pin 'the WIDER ledger's header figures are derived from its ARMS' reads these figures and is green.
- Instrument repair: the non-vacuity pin 'the enumeration can tell a union slot from a plain one' required the **ledger** to hold at least one union key. `logo` was the last one, so the pin went red on a shrinking ledger even though the unwrapper worked. Its union direction now also measures a fixed control slot outside the ledger, `SidebarSchema.content` (single-or-list, two arms). The single-arm direction still reads the ledger's own rows. After the merge, `WIDER_ARMS` holds zero multi-arm rows, so that control slot is now the only two-arm reading the pin gets. It passes.
- origin/main is merged twice, never rebased: `00cdaff1f` (merge `2ea13bc2a`), then `ce6bd99a5`, which is PR #10338 / objectui#10334 (merge `a74282b89`). The second merge conflicted only on the WIDER header paragraph. It was resolved by re-deriving the figures and keeping both history sentences in order. The merge changed nothing on this branch beyond the ledger figures: `navigation.ts`, `navigation.zod.ts` and the pin test are byte-identical to `968cd7698`.

## 4. Pins and reverse verification

`packages/types/src/__tests__/header-bar-unread-keys-10387.test.ts` has 19 tests. They cover:
- each of the eight keys refused BY NAME for a value from every arm either face admitted (including `logo` as a URL string, a node and a node list);
- the refusal's `code` and message head, naming what the renderer reads instead;
- a lit control: a document without the keys, and one with an undeclared key, both parse;
- a row showing that the keys the renderer does read still parse;
- a `@ts-expect-error` per key, checked by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.

Reverse verification ran from the committed state via objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor must hit, the blob must move, the file is restored to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` must be empty.

| leg | mutation | red / total |
|:--|:--|:--|
| nav (on `095636b79`) | old `z.array(NavLinkSchema)` arm restored | 2 / 11 |
| height (on `095636b79`) | old string-or-number arm restored | 2 / 11 |
| logo (on `968cd7698`) | old node-or-node-list arm restored | 2 / 19 |
| title (on `968cd7698`) | old `z.string()` arm restored | 2 / 19 |

In every leg the lit control stayed green. The restore is proven by the blob matching HEAD (`385141979aac` on `968cd7698`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## 5. Verification (head `a74282b89`; ablation and shape gate as noted)

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (src, examples and test projects) and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: exit 0.
- `vitest run packages/types/ examples/schema-catalog/` plus the three header-bar renderer tests: 265 files / 7437 tests passed on `a74282b89`.
- **Spec Main Shape Gate** (run on `968cd7698`, NOT re-run on `a74282b89`: that merge brought in main's objectui#10334 type change, so the shape-gate reading below is for the pre-merge tree; CI runs it on the merge):
  - built `@objectstack/spec` from objectstack `origin/main` `9d81af714f49` in a throwaway worktree and packed it;
  - `node scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject --tarball ... --sha 9d81af714f49... --upstream-checkout ...`: exit 0;
  - `TURBO_FORCE=true turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/types --filter=@object-ui/components`: 10/10 tasks;
  - `report --status 0`: "objectui type-checks against `@objectstack/spec` at that commit".
- These gates exit 0: `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols` (on the normal install), `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`. Reason: PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2); they need a 34-package build, so they are left to CI.
- ESLint, narrowed to the 7 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 7 files, 0 errors, 6 warnings. All six are `no-explicit-any` on lines this PR did not edit. The population is `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` in `eslint.config.js`. Type-aware linting is off, so this diff cannot change the lint result of any file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- `className` is also unread by `header-bar` (see the probe row above). The PM seat is filing it.
- `NavLinkSchema` / `NavLink` lose their `header-bar` consumer. `SidebarSchema.nav` still uses them.
- The Schema block in `header-bar.mdx` lists only `crumbs` and the base keys. Its usage note says the height is a fixed `h-16`, but the renderer uses `h-14 sm:h-16`. Neither is touched here.
- `check:spec-symbols` exits 1 while spec **main** is injected into the store. Spec main now exports names (for example `ObjectTimelineProps` and `ObjectTreeProps`) that plugin packages already declare locally. This comes from the spec bump, not from this diff: it is green on the normal install.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10387-header-bar-unread-keys-retired.md`: `minor` on `@object-ui/types`. The body has the breaking notes and the migration for all eight keys.
